_about: Benzene (1) + n-Butyl acetate (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.31 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of benzene, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of benzene, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: M. A. Postigo, A. Mariano, N. Zurakoski, A. F. Jara, Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibria for the Binary Systems Benzene + Methyl Ethanoate, Benzene + Butyl Ethanoate, and Benzene + Methyl Heptanoate at 101.31kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 54 (2009) 1575-1579
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
